home.domainTitle: Section, trọng số và tiến độ quiz

S1.n: Developing Code for Data Processing using Python and SQL

tasks.1.1: Implement scalable Python project structures for Declarative Automation Bundles
tasks.1.2: Troubleshoot dependency conflicts and installation failures for external libraries
tasks.1.3: Develop UDFs using Pandas, Python and SQL, including Unity Catalog functions
tasks.1.4: Create production-ready streaming pipelines using Lakeflow Pipelines and Auto Loader
tasks.1.5: Create and automate ETL workloads using Lakeflow Jobs via the UI, API and CLI
tasks.1.6: Choose between a streaming table and a materialized view
tasks.1.7: Implement CDC pipelines using AUTO CDC APIs, including SCD Type 1 and Type 2
tasks.1.8: Choose between Spark Structured Streaming and Apache Spark Declarative Pipelines
tasks.1.9: Create Lakeflow Jobs with control-flow operators (If/Else, For Each)
tasks.1.10: Choose compute and configuration, including serverless environments
tasks.1.11: Develop unit and integration tests (assertDataFrameEqual, assertSchemaEqual)
tasks.1.12: Apply Structured Streaming stateful semantics: watermarks, output modes, foreachBatch, checkpoints
tasks.2.1: Ingest a variety of data formats from message buses and cloud storage
tasks.2.2: Configure incremental CDC pipelines with Delta or Iceberg targets
tasks.2.3: Configure CDC ingestion from SQL Server, MySQL and PostgreSQL using Lakeflow Connect
tasks.2.4: Implement OpenSharing (D2D and Databricks-to-Open) and Clean Rooms
tasks.3.1: Apply window functions, joins and aggregations with Spark SQL and PySpark
tasks.3.2: Model and query semi-structured data using VARIANT
tasks.3.3: Apply AI functions, including ai_query, in data pipelines
tasks.3.4: Implement data quality expectations in Lakeflow Pipelines
tasks.4.1: Use system tables for cost analysis, auditing and workload monitoring
tasks.4.2: Use REST APIs, CLI and SDK to monitor jobs and pipelines
tasks.4.3: Use pipeline event logs to monitor pipeline health and data quality
tasks.4.5: Use Lakeflow Jobs UI and Jobs API to monitor job status and performance
tasks.5.1: Explain how UC managed tables, Predictive Optimization and Liquid Clustering cut overhead
tasks.5.2: Choose deletion vectors, Liquid Clustering or CLUSTER BY AUTO for an access pattern
tasks.5.3: Understand how caching (Delta cache) improves repeated reads
tasks.5.4: Apply Change Data Feed for incremental downstream processing
tasks.5.5: Use the query profile to find bottlenecks
tasks.6.1: Apply least-privilege ACLs on Unity Catalog securables and workspace resources
tasks.6.2: Apply ABAC policies with governed tags for row filters and column masks
tasks.6.4: Implement a compliant pipeline with PII detection and masking
tasks.6.5: Implement a data purging strategy (GDPR right-to-erasure)
tasks.7.1: Use Unity Catalog tags and comments for discoverability
tasks.7.2: Understand the Unity Catalog permission inheritance model
tasks.8.1: Find diagnostic information with Spark UI, cluster logs, system tables and query profiles
tasks.8.2: Repair failed job runs with job repairs and parameter overrides
tasks.8.3: Deploy Databricks resources using Declarative Automation Bundles
tasks.8.4: Configure Git-based CI/CD with Databricks Git folders
tasks.9.2: Design dimensional models with Materialized Views and Unity Catalog Metric Views
